auth_key.name: Access key (REQUIRED)
auth_key.description: This key protects the whole API and Web UI, and whoever holds it is granted admin rights. The add-on runs on the Home Assistant host network, so do not leave it empty and do not use a sample value — the application will refuse to start. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

base_url.name: Public URL
base_url.description: Only needed when reaching the add-on from outside your local network, e.g. https://chatgpt.example.com. Used to build image links. Leave empty for local-only use.
